x: For following a couple of ordinary clockings at the Nike Classic and in Budapest when still coping with jet lag, he flew to a 10.25 timing (his 3rd fastest legal mark) in Zurich on 22 August, only headed by Olympic Bronze Medallist Ben Johnson and Osvaldo Lara - winner of the Eastern Block 'Friendship' Games.

Public perception/appreciation of athletic performance is very tainted at present, and the all-time low the sport achieved following the 1988 Ben Johnson affair in Seoul has been closely matched by the recent close media scrutiny of British T&F.
